data.define: A casual word for good, or for agreeing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cool' when someone shares sad news.
misuse.why: It sounds like you don't care.

data.l1_hook: Filme hoje à noite às seis, "cool"?

native.tip: “cool” = legal; bacana; da hora. Exemplo: “Cool, see you at six!”
native.caption:
O que significa “cool”?
“cool” = legal; bacana; da hora.
Exemplo: “Cool, see you at six!” ("Cool", nos vemos às seis!)
